integrity: Complete proof and exactly reproducible finite enumeration are included; finite checks are not treated as geometric or asymptotic proofs. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The geometric result is for reduced algebraic subsets over algebraically closed fields, not their nonreduced schemes. Finite-field formulas require prime powers, and the asymptotic keeps q fixed. It does not address noncommuting quasi-nil-clean decompositions. Reiner and Gerstenhaber already imply fixed-characteristic-polynomial matrix counts; enumeration is not an independent priority assertion. Full text was accessible for Das–Kar and Abyzov–Chekhlov–Danchev–Tapkin, but not for the two Su–Liu matrix papers. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: The component geometry and finite-field census of strongly quasi-nil-clean matrices
